budget_granted: The board have found £{amount}m more for the pot: £{pot}m now. They will expect it to show: the target is {expectation}.
budget_refused: The board will not add to the pot. That is refusal {refusals} this season.
wages_granted: The board have raised the wage budget by £{amount}m to £{budget}m. They will expect it to show: the target is {expectation}.
wages_refused: The board will not raise the wage budget. That is refusal {refusals} this season.
backing_granted: The board have backed you in public. Credit up; the target is {expectation}.
backing_refused: The board said nothing. That is refusal {refusals} this season.
third_refusal: Three refusals in a season: the board are starting to find you difficult.
profile_set: The director has the profile: {profile}. Next week's names will follow it.
named_card: The director has looked at {name}: he will bring him as a card next week if the numbers work.
sell_found: The director has a buyer for {name}: {club} at £{fee}m. Approve the sale or keep him.
sell_none: No club wants {name} at the moment.
loan_found: {name} goes to {club} on loan for the rest of the season.
loan_none: No club will take {name} on loan.
loan_returned: {name} is back from his loan at {club}.
contract_granted: {name} will talk terms. His demand is on the desk.
contract_refused: {name} is not ready to sign anything just now.
captaincy_refused: {name} does not want the armband, and the asking unsettled him a little.
playingTime_granted: {name} has your word: {starts} starts in the next {weeks} weeks.
promise_broken: You promised {name} starts and he did not get them. The room noticed.
money: the fee is beyond the pot
wagebill: his wage would take the bill over budget
